purpose: Human requested training on other data. Reuse the existing locked KSDD2 publisher-TRAIN development roles, train one isolated candidate; no source reacquisition or completed v10/v17 job replay.

data_policy.development: Only existing original publisher TRAIN members already assigned fit/validation. All fixed CAL and publisher TEST stay held and unopened by this program. No new split, pixel audit, label change, sample substitution or group relaxation.
data_policy.GT: Existing KSDD2 paired native masks and positive/background convention only; >0 damage inside source rectangle, padding excluded. This is not a corrosion/other-source unknown-background rule or whole mechanical-health label.
data_policy.rights: Preserve previously registered CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 noncommercial research, attribution and share-alike conditions. Original author citation/source records remain required; do not substitute this protocol or code licence for data/parent/third-party rights.
data_policy.provenance_limits: The retained acquisition used an LFS mirror fixed at 82460be8a1b6470b110b0d8146624cb9d9bf2311 with archive SHA256 5ed01ab0b7fd006bdca4f7fc5fd614d28b8856203b2fedd551b49fbbadc79f07; publisher archive equivalence and publisher-provided checksum were not verified. No fresh original release/permission/checksum verification claimed. Existing historical authorization and audit are reused; no new source acceptance.
data_policy.group_limits: Exact RGB, any8orientation pHash<=2 and filename-block proxies from original fixed audit; physical acquisition identity and independent factory validation remain unverified. Reuse existing roles/graph, no full RGB/pHash recomputation or retrospective data-audit pass.

architecture: Same RuntimeRealMaskMain shared encoder. Clone accepted ksdd_head into a new ksdd_stream_v173 namespace; freeze parent entirely and cloned high_projection, train only cloned fusion. No new encoder, embedding, original API method override or app model.
preprocessing: Existing RGB bicubic aspect-preserving width256 height704 grey127 letterbox, nearest original mask resize, valid source rectangle, ImageNet normalization, frozen low40/high960 FP16 roundtrip then FP32 head. Actual paired RGB/mask H/V flips at p=.5 each for FIT only; no GT-based crop.
loss: Per photo balanced positive/known-background softplus BCE (.5/.5 when positive exists; background only on normal) + softDice + .5 top32-valid sigmoid photo BCE. Mean microbatch loss; no previous global pos_weight10. Padding excluded from every term.
initialization: Exact accepted v16 ksdd_head values, not a rejected later candidate. Same parent tensor/buffer/meta and normalization, v51 approved three heads and original v62 sidecars remain exact and unmodified.
sampling: Each of two microbatches has2 normal and2 real-defect FIT photos, replacement with inverse group multiplicity within label. Repeated draws/augmentation are not additional independent photos.
optimizer: AdamW, cosine12epoch, clip5, FP32, TF32off, cuDNN benchmarkoff/deterministicon. GPU kernels not promised bitwise deterministic. Record RNG/checkpoints/actual optimizer journal.
VAL_selection: Equal mean of normal-photo and defect-photo loss over fixed VAL389/52; epoch0 baseline is ineligible. Select earliest strict minimum among completed epochs1..12. If no VAL loss improvement over initialization, retain as non-improving development artifact; no CAL/TEST or promotion.
CAL_TEST_policy: This program performs zero CAL/TEST predictions. A later concrete preregistration must preserve CAL-save-before-fixedTEST-once, exact parent retention and all existing minima/FP/FN/pixel/runtime gates before any adoption. No new TEST threshold/stride/structure/coefficient sweep or score on held content.
delta: Bounded v16 parent_file/fileSHA/stateSHA + added/combined-stateSHA and serializedrestoreexact; record unchanged approved v51/v62 protected sidecars. No standalone full model, copied parent/cache, primary ZIP or runtime replacement.
resources: Per microbatch RGB streaming and frozen encoder; no feature cache, archive expansion/download or parent-file copy. Keep every epoch head+optimizer+RNG checkpoint and original files. Fresh scoped CIM/process/lock/GPU-context inventory and available RAM before run; WDDM desktop contexts are not assumed duplicate learning.
failure: Stop on changed input SHA/count/role, malformed decode/mask, nonfinite loss/gradient, resource cap, conflicting job/lock or any error. Preserve confirmed actual operations, partial state and failures. Exclusive new run path; no automatic resume/replay/minimum relaxation/cleanup.

publication.required_before_torch_dataset_pixels_fea: Exact script+protocol+report normal commit/push to feature/ai-engine and remote exact verification after new specific human authorization. Training request is not reuse of consumed prior publication approvals.
